answer: Each agent bonds stake and registers a Semaphore-style commitment, then evaluates the epoch polynomial to derive rate-limit nullifiers without disclosing its identity. The prism of zero-knowledge proofs lets peers verify each message while preserving privacy. If an agent repeats a message beyond its quota, the shared nullifier exposes enough Shamir shares to recover its private key, proving equivocation and triggering immediate slashing of bonded collateral; the nebula of identities remains private, while the grove enforces one accountable limit per agent.
